trust_decision.summary: Which stored client-side cookies go on an outgoing request is decided by CookieStorage.retrieve(), which at the pinned commit takes no request URI and returns every cookie regardless of the origin's domain, path or scheme; ClientFilters.Cookies attaches everything it gets back.

landing_point.why: The summary names BasicCookieStorage, and it is defined here. The default wiring sits next door at core/core/src/main/kotlin/org/http4k/filter/ClientFilters.kt:259.

public API: CookieStorage.retrieve(), whose signature becomes retrieve(uri: Uri) (fix.diff:120)
public API: BasicCookieStorage() is renamed to InsecureCookieStorage, and a new DefaultCookieStorage scopes by domain, path and Secure (fix.diff:123-227)
public API: ClientFilters.Cookies(clock, storage) default storage (fix.diff:65)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Http4kWebDriver is a testing-only in-memory browser for one app under test, so cross-origin cookie scoping looks irrelevant there; the published fix itself only changed its signature and still ignores the uri (fix.diff:597).

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Several behaviours must keep working. Cookies with a Domain attribute must still reach subdomains. Requests with relative or host-less URIs (Request(GET, "/set") then "/get") must still round-trip cookies. Expiry removal must keep working. LocalCookie must still survive a Jackson round trip. Http4kWebDriver must keep cookies across page navigations and redirects. An over-broad fix (exact host plus exact path only, or dropping cookies when the host is empty) breaks these.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Store-side Domain validation: a response from host X sets Domain=Y for an unrelated Y, and the cookie is then sent to Y. The published DefaultCookieStorage.store accepts any Domain (fix.diff:175-177); upstream added a domain-match check later (latest/core/core/src/main/kotlin/org/http4k/filter/cookie/clientCookies.kt:79,88-89).
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Engineers focus on retrieve-side matching and take the server's Domain attribute at face value; the published fix shipped exactly this gap.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: FollowRedirects keeps an already-attached Cookie header when it follows a redirect to a different host, so a Cookies filter placed outside FollowRedirects scopes only the first hop.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Filter ordering is user-chosen and the redirect code copies the whole request; upstream later added crossOriginSensitiveHeaders including Cookie (latest/core/core/src/main/kotlin/org/http4k/filter/ClientFilters.kt:171). This is arguably a separate redirect-header protection.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Expiry removal and remove(name) work by name across all origins, so an expired cookie from one origin evicts a same-named live cookie of another.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The remove(name) interface has no origin parameter, and the fix keeps it (fix.diff:205-207); maintainers could easily leave it as is.

O9_family: CWE-200 information exposure: client cookie jar with no RFC 6265 origin scoping (credentials leak across origins)
